data.title: BTC USD Price Prediction: Can Bitcoin Hold $64,000 Before Wednesday’s CPI Data Drop?
data.description: BTC USD is trading at $64,950, up a modest +0.2% on the day, after briefly punching through $65,400 in early August 10 trading. That’s not a breakout yet, as it’s already lost the $65,000 level. The bigger question is whether Wednesday’s inflation print turns this into a real move or ...
